The '''Light Racer''' was a [[starship]] that operated around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], it arrived at [[Nova Station]], where the arrival was indicated in the [[Big Boom]] Cantina.
